The Pistol Squat: A little counterweight can make a big difference.
Struggling with balance or reaching full depth in your Pistol Squat?
Try holding a light weight in front of you. A small counterweight shifts your center of mass forward, making it easier to maintain balance, stay upright, and control the descent. Sometimes, adding a little weight actually makes the exercise easier.
Another option is the Crane-Style Pistol, where you hold the foot of your non-working leg with your hand.
